decisions.decision: Build all five parts in a worktree branched from origin/main (branch t300-ruled-out-cleanup). (1) Delete instantly.ts, m365.ts, jobs-m365.ts, the HeyReach, Calendly, SendGrid ('sendgrid-domain' in JobId and admin.js) and email-verifier jobs, the dashboard.ts stats and the admin M365 setting. Fix every import and reader. Leave the Google Workspace mailbox and warmup cards alone, because T-299 owns them. (2) Add a generic 'Disconnect and delete key' action for any stored credential whose provider is on the ruled-out list. Show it in the attendee's connections area and make it wipe the stored row. (3) Rewrite 'verified list' and 'Verify every email' in the Backlinko voice: the vendor delivers the list already verified, and we run dedupe, format and company-domain checks. (4) Update survey.html and regenerate the survey. (5) Add a denylist to probe-visual-tools.mjs. Don't touch real-growth.ts. Before editing shared lines, grep LOG.md for T-272 and T-264. Run the Done-when checks, then post READY.
